functions-for-registry-writes-that-end-i.text: Names, argument names and result types only, with no bodies.

chained-view-module.text: The chained view module answers a query, an asset history and a mint record as if the staged transactions had landed, and builds the session that serves those answers over a real one. The history is numbered after the held view's tip height and honours the read's range, as a list and as a stream.

write-session-module.text: The write session keeps its signature; the write settings carry the signer. A pure function assembles the bundle of a staged run.

receipt-module.text: The receipt module journals the waiting lines with the saved bundle and bodies, and computes the members and the bundle states from the journal, purely.

reconciliation-module.text: The reconciliation reads the inclusion of unsettled members and the tip, appends landed and dead lines, and admission stops on a pending bundle with status 19.

submit-command-module.text: The submit core takes a bundle, its bytes and the witnesses in memory; the file front reads the files and calls it.

sign-command-module.text: A pure function gives the detached witness of every transaction of a checked bundle.

flag-group-module.text: The shared write reader keeps its arguments; the write settings it builds now carry the signer read from the flags in place of the key-file path.

managed-state-module.text: The partition is resolved from a key file, an address or a vault, by payment key hash.
